⚽ Club Legacy: Soccer Manager ⚽

Build your football club. Lead your team. Write your legacy! 🏆

⭐ FEATURES ⭐
🛡️ Create and customize your club
🧠 Manage tactics and formations
📺 Watch live 3D matches
💎 Scout, sign and train players
🏆 Win titles and promotions
👥 Compete with friends and other managers
🌍 Climb global rankings

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get updates!

⚠️ ALPHA TEST ⚠️
Club Legacy is in early testing (alpha). You may find bugs and unfinished features.
